bounded_change: Only row carrier_zero, equally for previous/current and probe0/probe1, appends -Wno-error=div-by-zero. -Werror and all other flags, UBSan and every existing numeric/transcript/interface assertion remain. Exactly one retained nonfatal division-by-zero warning is required, and the full diagnostic must fit the saved receipt. All other rows retain unmodified flags. FREEZE pointer advances to independent_freeze02.json.
cause: The synthetic config carrier=0 makes GCC diagnose the original predecessor statement rate/carrier despite the earlier zero-carrier return. With -Werror the fixture cannot reach runtime guard validation. The observed failure is on the unchanged predecessor, not a new implementation calculation.
